name: fs-operation-scope-enforced
body: Law (prose; assessed by review): a filesystem operation (`apg_rm` / `apg_mv` / `apg_cp`) may touch ONLY a path matched by the acting agent's granted globs — the source path, and for mv/cp the destination path as well. The TOOL enforces this: it reads the acting agent's granted globs from its agent permission block (via the opencode plugin context), resolves those globs and the candidate path in ONE consistent frame, and refuses a path outside that scope; enforcement does not live in the permission layer's matching of the tool's path argument. The boundary is the PROJECT WORKTREE: for a code-writer, a path that resolves into the main checkout (outside every project worktree) is refused regardless of the caller-supplied directory, and no operation may cross the project/worktree boundary. The capability is never granted as a blanket `"*": allow`: the grant is deny-by-default with the role's owned globs allowed under `apg/.worktrees/*/` only. The tools perform plain filesystem operations only — they are not `git rm`/`git mv` — and they never mutate graph nodes (that is `apg node rm` / `apg edge rm`).
